div.head: Northu 58
div.ab: Gif cyninges þegn oððe ænig landrica hit forhæbbe, gilde X healfmarc, healf Criste healf cynge.
Gif cyninges þegn oððe ænig landrica hit forhæbbe, gilde X healfmarc: healf Criste, healf cynge.
Wenn ein Königsthegn oder irgend ein Grundherr es vorenthält, zahle er 10 Halbmark, halb Christo [dem Bischof], halb dem Könige.
If a king's thegn or any landlord withholds it, let him pay 10 half-marks, half to Christ [the bishop], half to the king.
If a king’s thegn or any lord of an estate withholds it, he is to pay 10 half-marks, half to Christ and half to the king.
If a king’s thane or any local lord holds it back, he is to pay ten half-marks: half to Christ, half to the king.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.

Liebermann compares EGu 6.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a king' thegn or any lord of an estate withholds it, he is to pay 10 half-marks, half to Christ and half to the king.’).
